purpose: Construct and preserve a source-addressable declarative constraint candidate without scientific execution or evaluation.

required.statement: Accept exactly the required opaque candidate input and canonical provenance for TLC-FC-13-PRACTICE-001.
Preserve TLC-SO-PRACTICE-045, INPUT-PRACTICE-001-1, OUTPUT-PRACTICE-001-1, documentary order, opaque payloads, reservations, and traceability.
Provide deterministic structural construction, validation, canonical serialization, deserialization, comparison, and trace inspection.

forbidden.statement: Do not infer or execute a constraint predicate, numerical method, type, dimension, unit, threshold, temporal rule, progression, or effect.
Do not modify opaque values or publish a partial successful result after failure.

deferred.statement: Scientific execution and evaluation require external providers; the candidate output semantics remain unresolved.

operations.purpose: Validate and return the immutable declarative representation for the cited Practice constraint candidate.

constraints.statement: The required input is present under candidate status and remains opaque.

preconditions.statement: The feature identity, required input identifier, covered object, contract, source IR, and scientific source references are canonical.
The opaque input is supplied under candidate status.

postconditions.statement: The returned representation preserves TLC-SO-PRACTICE-045 and all source references exactly.
Opaque values remain unchanged and no scientific result is asserted.

invariants.statement: The constraint remains a candidate source fragment rather than an executable predicate.
No absent scientific type, unit, threshold, method, temporal semantic, progression, or effect is introduced.

steps: preserve opaque payloads and documentary order

partial_order.before: preserve opaque payloads and documentary order

prescription_basis: Validation, preservation, complete metadata, deterministic structure, and atomic publication are observable; internal sequencing is open.

error_contract.condition: Source error id invalid_feature_identity: the feature identity differs from TLC-FC-13-PRACTICE-001.
Source error id missing_required_input: INPUT-PRACTICE-001-1 is absent.
Source error id invalid_input_type: the required value is not carried opaquely.
Source error id missing_source_reference: TLC-SO-PRACTICE-045 lacks its canonical reference.
Source error id provenance_mismatch: a contract, IR, source, object, input, or output reference differs from the canonical set.
Source error id structural_error: the declarative representation violates this contract.
Source error id external_executor_required: scientific execution is requested without an external executor.
Source error id external_evaluator_required: scientific evaluation is requested without an external evaluator.
Source error id implementation_out_of_scope: the request asks for an undeclared procedure or scientific effect.

implementation_modes.statement: Expose the deterministic declarative representation and stable errors.
Do not supply a default constraint predicate, executor, evaluator, or scientific result.
Internal architecture remains free when all observable obligations are preserved.

global_invariants.statement: Scientific opacity, candidate status, exact identity, and complete traceability cannot be weakened.
Structural validity never authorizes scientific truth or execution.

dependencies.purpose: Stable source object and input identities

notes: Conformance is structural and does not authorize scientific execution or evaluation.
